answer: Soulbound attestations are non-transferable and expire unless renewed. A bought attestation cannot move to a new key, so 260 aliases need 260 separately earned attestations. Expiry is enforced by the contract, and renewal needs the issuer's fresh signature. The summit check runs in the open: 260 fakes pay the full price 260 times, one honest agent pays once, and the grove trail in the ledger makes the marble cost visible to everyone.
